product.name: CarLogik Online Auto Service Marketplace
product.description: An online platform that allows customers to compare prices and book auto repair and maintenance services with vetted workshops.

product.name: Major Vehicle Service
product.description: Comprehensive periodic maintenance involving inspections and replacement of necessary parts to ensure vehicle operation at specific mileage intervals.

product.name: Minor Vehicle Service
product.description: Basic vehicle maintenance primarily involving oil and oil filter changes along with recommended checks at manufacturer intervals.

product.name: Spark Plug Replacement
product.description: Replacement of spark plugs to maintain engine ignition efficiency and prevent performance issues.

product.name: Air Conditioning (AC) Filter Replacement
product.description: Replacement of the vehicle’s AC filter to ensure clean air circulation inside the cabin and maintain HVAC system efficiency.

product.name: Battery Replacement
product.description: Replacement of vehicle batteries to restore electrical power and ensure reliable engine starting.
